name: io.github.aartiq/nowaikit
title: NowAIKit: MCP server for ServiceNow
description: AI toolkit for ServiceNow: 500+ tools for Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot and any MCP client.

environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth application client ID (for oauth auth)

environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth application client secret (for oauth auth)

environmentVariables.name: SCRIPTING_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Enable script changes such as business rules and changesets (true/false, default: false; script reads are always available)

environmentVariables.name: CMDB_WRITE_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Enable CMDB write operations (true/false, default: false)

environmentVariables.name: NOW_ASSIST_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Enable Now Assist (Otto) generative AI tools (true/false, default: false)

environmentVariables.name: ATF_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Enable ATF test execution (true/false, default: false)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TOOL_PACKAGE
environmentVariables.description: Role-based tool package: full (default), service_desk, change_coordinator, knowledge_author, catalog_builder, system_administrator, platform_developer, itom_engineer, agile_manager, ai_developer, portal_developer, integration_engineer, devops_engineer, itam_analyst

environmentVariables.name: TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode: stdio (default), sse, or http

environmentVariables.name: PORT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP server port (default: 3000, for sse/http transport)

environmentVariables.name: NOWAIKIT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for API authentication (sse/http transport)

environmentVariables.name: FLUENT_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Enable Fluent SDK tools (true/false, default: false)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TOOL_DISCOVERY
environmentVariables.description: Tool discovery mode: lean (small core plus search_tools), core, or unset for every tool

environmentVariables.name: SN_INSTANCES_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to an instances.json file for multi-instance setups

environmentVariables.name: NOWAIKIT_MCP_APPS
environmentVariables.description: Interactive forms (MCP Apps) in supporting clients: unset for auto, false to turn off
